title: The hardware panel, sharper
thisBuild: New Look: the hardware panel. Bakelite keys in worn metal, a glass lamp that lights when a key is on, and glyphs cut from your own drawings. Settings, Look switches back to Classic or Pro any time.

Sharper panel (Nov 21 evening): the keys use worn rubber-stamp letters, the small words under icons are stencilled, and the BPM and loop read out on an amber LCD face. Icons are inlaid in their own colours, aged a little, at whole-pixel sizes so they stay crisp, with an engraved shadow. Buttons whose word has an icon show both. Every key on the top bar is the same size now.

Every sheet, tray and strip comes off with the screw in its corner (tap it and it turns out), and Back does the same. The lanes in Steps, the row tools, the loops strip and the key panel all have one now.
Flick a pad up to open its Edit tray. Edit, then the pad, still works.
Repeat's rate and pattern are two separate words under RPT, each with its own menu: how fast, and Up, Down, Up-down, Random or a rest pattern.
Steps and Roll are one tab, Seq, with a Steps or Roll switch at the top. Perform is a new tab: the throws, the Mud filter, and the picked pad's XY square and FX faders.

Fixes: an empty pad only records or opens the picker on a still tap's lift; lessons work in the new layout; help text no longer talks about Menu and the side dock; the key shows the chord only with Chords on; Send all without the key puts every waiting note on one GitHub page, newest first, each with when it was written.
watch: Play for ten minutes on the panel Look: do the keys feel like hardware, and is every word readable?
Flick pads up while the loop plays: does the tray ever open when you only meant to play?
Close everything with the screw or Back: is anything still stuck open?
limits: The glyphs are your Pro icons cut to one colour; a few may read better redrawn bigger.
Not built yet: the pad grid filling the screen at 70% view, a tap that only turns a step on or off, a shorter Edit tray for faders. They are in the proposal doc waiting for your call.
